stories.title: Trump may have lost but don’t bet Democrats can fix the economy
stories.summary: There’s not much they can do over the next couple of years to alleviate angry voters’ stress over prices It was the economy, again. Although Donald Trump largely ignored it, voters’ acute concerns over the rising cost of living fuelled a political upheaval for the ages that is likely to deliver the biggest swing toward Democrats since Watergate, granting them the largest House majority in nearly four decades alongside their biggest edge in the Senate since 2008. Still, having come to power promising to restore affordability, the new crop of Democrats are soon to discover that there is not much they can do over the next couple of years to alleviate angry voters’ stress over pricey gas and groceries, exorbitant mortgages and unaffordable healthcare. stories.summary: Wondering how rain-affected matches are decided in cricket? How the DLS method works in ODIs and T20Is, and how targets are adjusted fairly when weather interrupts play. The DLS method is used to determine fair targets in rain-affected limited-overs matches. The method is exclusively applied to limited-overs formats like ODIs and T20Is and is not used in Test cricket. Many matches, including World Cup games, have been decided by the DLS method, occasionally leading to significant debate. The method's name is derived from its creators Frank Duckworth and Tony Lewis, including the updated inputs from Steven Stern. Which is how the name, Duckworth-Lewis-Stern (DLS) method was coined.

stories.summary: The England and Wales Cricket Board (ECB) is forecasting losses of tens of millions of pounds next year despite hosting the Ashes, with county executives told last week that the deficit could be as large as £50m The anticipated shortfall, after posting a profit of £12.6m in 2025, is due to a combination of the cyclical nature of the governing body’s media revenues, which is largely determined by domestic opposition, and a recent decision by the International Cricket Council (ICC) to withhold a portion of the broadcast payments owed to members that it had been due to distribute in 2027.
